about: Shared by workers/voice-recognition/tests/test_host.py and tests/Martlet.Desktop.Tests/VoiceRecognitionHostTests.cs: the host's port of SpeakerEngine.Clean and .NET's Math.Round(x, 2) must give these answers, as the desktop's engine does. Times are seconds.

clean.name: one long turn is trimmed at both edges
another voice cuts a turn in two, longest first
touching turns of one voice merge
a stretch shorter than 1.5 s after trimming is dropped
a voice talked over all the time has no clean speech
equal lengths keep the earlier first
the short voice inside a long one has none
